table.name: hryvinskyi_rich_snippets_snippet
table.comment: Rich snippets: one JSON-LD block a shop writes, with where it is output

column.name: snippet_id
column.comment: Snippet ID, internal to the module; includes and imports match by code

column.name: code
column.comment: Stable code includes and imports match by; never changes

column.name: name
column.comment: Name, seen in the admin only

column.name: type
column.comment: First schema.org type of the template's root, kept for listing

column.name: is_block
column.comment: Building block: output only inside the snippets that include it

column.name: active
column.comment: Switched on; always off for a building block

column.name: page_kinds
column.comment: Kinds of page, a JSON list of codes

column.name: conditions
column.comment: Conditions, the expression builder's JSON text kept as written; empty for none

column.name: store_ids
column.comment: Store views, a JSON list of store IDs; 0 is every store view

column.name: template
column.comment: The JSON template, the source of truth of the snippet

column.name: origin_code
column.comment: Code of the library template the snippet was added from

column.name: origin_version
column.comment: Version of the library template the snippet was added from

column.name: sort_order
column.comment: Output order on a page; ties break by ID

column.name: created_at
column.comment: Created at

column.name: updated_at
column.comment: Updated at

column.name: updated_by
column.comment: User name of the admin who saved last; empty for a save without one

table.name: hryvinskyi_rich_snippets_idempotency
table.comment: Rich snippets: results of creating writes by idempotency key, so a replay answers the first result

column.name: entry_id
column.comment: Entry ID, internal to the module

column.name: idempotency_key
column.comment: The key the admin page generated once for one intent

column.name: action
column.comment: The write the key was used for

column.name: result
column.comment: The answer of the first write, as JSON

column.name: created_at
column.comment: Created at; old entries are pruned

table.name: hryvinskyi_rich_snippets_observation
table.comment: Rich snippets: what the last page test saw of the theme's own microdata, per store view and kind

column.name: observation_id
column.comment: Observation ID, internal to the module

column.name: store_id
column.comment: Store view the page belongs to

column.name: kind
column.comment: Code of the page's kind

column.name: found
column.comment: Whether the page carried schema.org microdata

column.name: properties
column.comment: The items seen, a JSON list of their type and property names

column.name: path
column.comment: Path of the page read, from the base address on

column.name: seen_at
column.comment: When the page was read

table.name: hryvinskyi_rich_snippets_check_run
table.comment: Rich snippets: catalog checks, requested, running or finished

column.name: run_id
column.comment: Run ID, internal to the module

column.name: state
column.comment: requested, running, done or failed

column.name: triggered_by
column.comment: What asked for the run: schedule, manual or import

column.name: pending
column.comment: 1 while the run is requested or running, else empty; unique, so one run waits at a time

column.name: requested_at
column.comment: When the run was asked for, UTC

column.name: started_at
column.comment: When the run was claimed, UTC

column.name: finished_at
column.comment: When the run ended, UTC

column.name: heartbeat_at
column.comment: When the running check last reported progress, UTC

column.name: pages_total
column.comment: Pages to check, one per page and store view

column.name: pages_checked
column.comment: Pages checked so far, one per page and store view

column.name: store_views
column.comment: Store views the run checks

column.name: failure
column.comment: Why a failed run stopped: stale or error

table.name: hryvinskyi_rich_snippets_check_finding
table.comment: Rich snippets: gaps in the shop's data a catalog check found, per run, store view and kind of gap

column.name: finding_id
column.comment: Finding ID, internal to the module

column.name: run_id
column.comment: The run that found it

column.name: store_id
column.comment: The store view it was found in

column.name: finding_key
column.comment: Stable key of the kind of gap: result type, property path and variables read

column.name: rule_code
column.comment: Code of the kind of Google result that misses something

column.name: path
column.comment: Property path that is missing; empty when the whole result is left out

column.name: sources
column.comment: JSON list of the variable paths the template read and found empty

column.name: tone
column.comment: bad, warn or note

column.name: snippets
column.comment: JSON list of the codes of the snippets that wrote the pages

column.name: pages
column.comment: Pages with the gap

column.name: pages_by_kind
column.comment: JSON object of the pages with the gap by kind of page

table.name: hryvinskyi_rich_snippets_check_finding_item
table.comment: Rich snippets: every page of a finding, kept for the latest finished and the running check only

column.name: finding_id
column.comment: The finding

column.name: kind
column.comment: Code of the page's kind

column.name: entity_id
column.comment: The entity the page shows; 0 for a page that shows none

table.name: hryvinskyi_rich_snippets_check_aggregate
table.comment: Rich snippets: the counts of a catalog check per store view; store view 0 is every store view

column.name: run_id
column.comment: The run counted

column.name: store_id
column.comment: The store view counted; 0 for every store view together

column.name: metric
column.comment: What is counted

column.name: subject
column.comment: What the count is about: a kind of page, a result type, a snippet code; empty for none

column.name: value
column.comment: The count
